method: Read-only source/coverage audit and local HTTP/artifact byte comparison. No browser input, hidden state, new gameplay, build, tests, game edits, index edits, commit or push.

build.limit: Fresh HTTP identity verified. Preserved Chrome tabs were not inspected or reloaded and may retain earlier packs. Gameplay JS remains index-TazYPRJa.js; latest data changes are source attribution only.

coverageAtAudit.note: Index describes prior 1757 round; current 1827 browser outcomes are not yet included.
coverageAtAudit.currentRoundPlan: Root continues Dilsukh collected customer leg at previously recorded 120 m; west Kompally and east Miyapur receive sequential exclusive turns. Plan is not evidence of completion.

PT011.status: Confirmed immediate-pause failure in two prior areas; no-pause control still absent in index at audit.
PT011.hypothesis: The single 2500 ms post-handover callback skips showOffer while pause modal is open. Resume does not retry. Strongly source-supported explanation, not instrumented event timing.
visibleNoPauseProtocol: After stopping at a visible Hold E handover prompt, hold E at least 0.9 s.
Capture an explicit delivery reward plus wallet/progress change; proximity or zero distance is insufficient.
Keep the game foreground and unpaused for at least 5.5 s after actual completion. Do not open map, pause, settings, theatre or area picker, and do not switch tabs.
Capture the actual New order card with Accept/Another, or document absence with elapsed time. Waiting-for-order HUD and a level-up toast do not establish a new offer.
PT011.laterComparison: On a separate completed order, pause before 2500 ms, remain paused past that callback, then resume. Deduplicate against PT011; Change area→Stay here previously restored offers.

fullMapCoverageProposal.interpretation: The 16 popular buttons are navigation shortcuts. Their completion cannot establish coverage of the full 57 km × 48 km declared extent, and one sample cannot certify an entire pack or tile.

fullMapCoverageProposal.foodCountLimit: These are raw shipped food-list counts used to anticipate short vs sparse routes, not verified restaurants, guaranteed order eligibility or real-world business accuracy. Shamirpet has only 1 such entry within 800 m, so expect a wider offer search.
visibleMapSequence: Finish an active accepted order before relocating; use a fresh test session if preserving an unfinished order.
Use Pause→Change area→Search an area for an exact source-backed anchor, or Pick a spot on the map.
For map picking, drag/zoom the rendered map until the pin and visible area label identify the desired next road; click Start delivering here. Record selected label and before/after screenshot.
While an offer is pending, test picker Cancel, actual Close and Stay here restoration before accepting.
Drive a short named arterial-to-side-street segment; capture junction/traffic/curb behavior and an actual pickup/handover if reached. Retain exact stopping state if unfinished.
fullMapCoverageProposal.boundedRoundAllocation: Continue one incomplete delivery plus at most two new anchors per bounded round; choose a different outer sector next time, then fill gaps between tested anchors.
suggestedCoverageEvidence: Record anchor, visible road/area names, selected map position, viewport, before/after screenshots and explicit interactions.
Separate not_visited, loaded_only, driven_partial and interaction_completed; mark only the actual observed route segment.
Use manifest tile/pack grid for planning, not as proof that a driven path or entire tile was verified.
Keep street/shop reconstruction evidence separate: no gameplay drive certifies real facade binding, shop order or current operation.
fullMapCoverageProposal.sourceOnlySearchCaution: AreaPicker sorts localities before macrohoods and deduplicates identical names. Two Kondapur records map to different positions; the eastern locality is selected first. Bolarum also duplicates across kinds. Avoid those ambiguous labels in the first expansion pass; inspect visible map position. This is a source finding, not a newly reproduced UI issue.
